{{Quote|Madam, this bank IS the economy.|Jideon Praji, to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tash Metonae]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]|<ref name="Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref>}}
'''Jideon Praji''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of [[House Praji/Legends|House Praji]] who lived during the final century of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Praji was the [[Bank of the Core Executive Board Chair|Chairman]] of the [[Bank of the Core/Legends|Bank of the Core]], and was appointed as [[Minister of Finance (Republic)|Republic Minister of Finance]] by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Vaila Pecivas]] sometime before her resignation in [[60 BBY/Legends|60 BBY]]. However, he only served as minister for a few days, as his appointment caused a [[holomedia]] uproar over the perceived conflict of interest. Following a [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senatorial]] inquiry, he was forced to step down.
